description.narrative:
Project Outcomes: Stakeholder Effects: The main Project outcomes include increased access to customized green financing to real estate developers for the construction of green residential housing units. The fund is focused on supply side financing which is expected to enable the development of affordable and mid-income green housing units in Tier I and Tier II cities in India.
Contribution to Market Creation Integration: The project aims to create a specialized fund which provides a tailored and innovative product for financing the development of affordable green housing in India. This initiative will infuse fresh capital into the climate finance sector and encourage the issuance of green finance instruments by real estate developers. The project's success will demonstrate the economic feasibility of innovative financing structures and attract long-term capital into the sector.

The proposed project entails an IFC investment of up to US$ 150 million in HDFC Capital Development of Real Estate Affordable and Mid-Income Fund 1 by HDFC Capital AIF 4 (H-DREAM Fund), an innovative fund focused on investing in senior, secured green loans and other debt instruments issued by developers of for-sale, green residential real estate. The H-DREAM Fund will have a target corpus of US$ 1 billion (US$ 500 million with a green shoe of US$ 500 million) and will be managed by the real estate private equity arm of HDFC Group, HDFC Capital Advisors Limited (HDFC Capital). The H-DREAM Fund will be established as a SEBI Category II Alternate Investment Fund (AIF). The residential housing projects financed by the H-DREAM Fund will adhere to the IFC Excellence in Design for Greater Efficiencies (EDGE) green building framework and will be focused on the affordable and mid-income housing segments in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities across India.
